policy.construction: each literal first parsed to binary64, then exact integer ratio at every precision; Cartesian off-diagonals divide exact Mandel values by high-precision sqrt(2)
policy.source_route: Cartesian AppendixC; T=-sigma,D=-E; zero spin; Eq38 PLUS agrees with40/84; no ideal eigenvalues or Atlas evaluation
policy.trigonometry: stdlib Decimal Taylor sin/cos on exact binary64 phi; stop when term abs<10^(-precision-5)
policy.conditioning: determinant relative Frobenius derivative amplification ||sigma||F ||adj(sigma)||F / abs(det sigma); determinant cancellation sum(abs(cofactor-expansion terms))/abs(det); adjacent-binary64 perturb each nonzero one of6Mandel stress entries up/down at240digits, record SPD and source-rate changes
policy.perturbation_qualification: adjacent stored inputs only, not evaluation error certificate; no ideal-spectrum perturbations; no domain changes
policy.backend_diagnostic: compare retained backend rates to converged240digit source estimates componentwise; descriptive only, no new retroactive accuracy gate
policy.failure_policy: retain source/convergence/domain failures; do not relax tolerances, rescale ideal input, rewrite references or change support
